config.name: app.json
config.summary: Expo application configuration defining app name, slug, icons, splash screen, platform settings, and plugins for the React Native mobile build.

config.name: eas.json
config.summary: EAS Build configuration defining build profiles (development, preview, production) and submit settings for producing iOS and Android binaries via Expo Application Services.

config.name: manifest.json
config.summary: PWA web app manifest declaring name, icons, theme/background colors, display mode, and orientation so the standalone web game can be installed to a home screen.

config.name: netlify.toml
config.summary: Netlify deployment configuration defining the build/publish settings and custom HTTP response headers (caching, security) for hosting the standalone web PWA.

config.name: package.json
config.summary: npm manifest for the Expo/React Native app declaring start/android/ios/web scripts and runtime dependencies including Expo, Expo Router, Firebase, and AsyncStorage.

config.name: tsconfig.json
config.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration extending the Expo base config with the @/* path alias to src/* and node moduleResolution required for Firebase v10 web SDK type resolution.

config.name: .npmrc
config.summary: npm configuration enabling legacy-peer-deps so installs ignore strict peer-dependency conflicts, accommodating the Firebase v10 / Expo dependency tree.

config.name: babel.config.js
config.summary: Babel configuration for the Expo app applying the babel-preset-expo preset and enabling the API cache for faster rebuilds.

config.name: firestore.rules
config.summary: Firestore security rules governing access to rooms, matchmaking, users, and coinTransactions collections: authenticated reads/writes for rooms and matchmaking, owner-scoped user docs, and read-only audit-trail coin transactions.

file:app/leaderboard.tsx.name: leaderboard.tsx
file:app/leaderboard.tsx.summary: Expo Router screen that fetches and renders the global player leaderboard ranked by coin balance, highlighting the current user's row.

file:app/lobby.tsx.name: lobby.tsx
file:app/lobby.tsx.summary: Online lobby screen for creating or joining a multiplayer room by code, validating input, and navigating to the online game once a match is established.

file:app/shop.tsx.name: shop.tsx
file:app/shop.tsx.summary: Theme shop screen showing the coin balance and purchasable themes, handling theme purchases and activation via the coins service.

file:src/services/coins.ts.name: coins.ts
file:src/services/coins.ts.summary: Firestore-backed coin service handling user profile bootstrap, balance read/subscribe, awarding and spending coins, daily bonus, online-result rewards, and theme ownership/activation.

file:src/services/firebase.ts.name: firebase.ts
file:src/services/firebase.ts.summary: Initializes the Firebase web SDK app, Firestore, and anonymous auth, exporting the shared instances plus a helper to obtain the current anonymous UID.

file:src/services/gameRoom.ts.name: gameRoom.ts
file:src/services/gameRoom.ts.summary: Firestore game-room service managing room lifecycle: code generation, board flatten/unflatten serialization, create/join, move application, turn skipping, abandon, and rematch.

file:src/services/leaderboard.ts.name: leaderboard.ts
file:src/services/leaderboard.ts.summary: Service that queries Firestore for top users ordered by coin balance and returns a ranked leaderboard list.

file:src/services/matchmaking.ts.name: matchmaking.ts
file:src/services/matchmaking.ts.summary: Quick-match matchmaking service managing a Firestore queue: joining, cancelling, listening for a match, scanning the waiting pool, and atomically pairing two players into a room.

file:app/_layout.tsx.name: _layout.tsx
file:app/_layout.tsx.summary: Expo Router root layout that loads custom fonts, restores the persisted theme from AsyncStorage, and wraps the app in ThemeContext before rendering the navigation Stack.

file:app/game.tsx.name: game.tsx
file:app/game.tsx.summary: Local game screen for 2-player and AI modes; drives the useGameEngine hook, renders GameBoard and ScoreBar, plays sound effects, and awards coins and records stats on game end.

file:app/online-game.tsx.name: online-game.tsx
file:app/online-game.tsx.summary: Online multiplayer game screen backed by useOnlineGame (Firestore); renders the shared GameBoard and ScoreBar, disables input when it is not the player's turn, and awards coins on result.

file:src/components/GameBoard.tsx.name: GameBoard.tsx
file:src/components/GameBoard.tsx.summary: SVG-based dots-and-boxes board component that renders dots, lines, and filled boxes, highlights the last move and new boxes, and emits onLineTap for player input.

file:src/components/ScoreBar.tsx.name: ScoreBar.tsx
file:src/components/ScoreBar.tsx.summary: Header bar component showing both players' names and scores, the active turn indicator, AI-thinking state, and a countdown timer when enabled.

file:src/hooks/useTheme.ts.name: useTheme.ts
file:src/hooks/useTheme.ts.summary: Defines the theme system: ThemeTokens interface, the THEMES token map (parchment/neon/chalkboard/blueprint), THEME_META display metadata, the ThemeContext, and the useTheme hook consumers use to read the active theme.

file:src/services/audio.ts.name: audio.ts
file:src/services/audio.ts.summary: Sound-effects service that procedurally synthesizes WAV tones (click, pop, chain, win, draw, timer beep) as base64, loads them via expo-av, and exposes initAudio and playSound for the game screens.

file:src/ai/aiPlayer.ts.name: aiPlayer.ts
file:src/ai/aiPlayer.ts.summary: Pure AI opponent strategy module exposing a single getAIMove entry point with three difficulty tiers (easy random, medium heuristic, hard minimax with alpha-beta pruning and chain avoidance).

file:src/hooks/useGameEngine.ts.name: useGameEngine.ts
file:src/hooks/useGameEngine.ts.summary: React hook driving the local (2-player and vs-AI) game: manages board state, turn switching, scoring, undo history, per-turn timer, AI move scheduling, and emits gameplay events to the UI.

file:src/hooks/useOnlineGame.ts.name: useOnlineGame.ts
file:src/hooks/useOnlineGame.ts.summary: React hook backing online multiplayer games via Firestore: subscribes to the room document, reconstructs board state from flattened arrays, submits moves, handles turn timer/auto-skip, abandonment, and rematch.

file:src/types/game.types.ts.name: game.types.ts
file:src/types/game.types.ts.summary: Central type hub declaring all shared game domain types (GameState, GameMode, Line, Player, board owner arrays, config and event interfaces) consumed across hooks, components, services, and screens.

file:src/utils/gameHelpers.ts.name: gameHelpers.ts
file:src/utils/gameHelpers.ts.summary: Pure game-logic utilities: builds initial board state, detects completed boxes, enumerates available lines, counts box sides, simulates line application, and snapshots state for undo.

file:app/index.tsx.name: index.tsx
file:app/index.tsx.summary: Home/settings screen and app entry point: configures game mode, grid size, player names, timer and difficulty, displays stats and coin balance, drives the Quick Match matchmaking flow, and routes into local/AI/online games.

file:src/components/TutorialOverlay.tsx.name: TutorialOverlay.tsx
file:src/components/TutorialOverlay.tsx.summary: Multi-step interactive tutorial overlay that walks new players through dots & boxes rules using a live GameBoard preview, persisting the seen flag on completion.

file:src/utils/storage.ts.name: storage.ts
file:src/utils/storage.ts.summary: AsyncStorage-backed persistence layer for local preferences (mode, grid, names, timer, difficulty), win/loss stats, tutorial-seen flag, and sound preference.
